'''Jarth Findo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Jarth Findo was born in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and joined the [[Special missions company|Special Missions Company]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. However, after his company was nearly defeated by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces, Findo chose to desert. A group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] were sent to hunt him down and he was barely able to evade them. Afterward, Findo established a small group of mercenaries, that was based in the [[Duro sector/Legends|Duro sector]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 13,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Findo's head after his mercenaries raided several of their bases.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Findo first appeared in the [[1993]] book [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a supplementary book for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Jackson]]<ref name="WBC" /> who used [[Jens Hausser]] as a model, although Jackson lamented that he could never get his drawings to look the same as Hausser.<ref>{{DeviantArt|username=steampoweredmikej|url=steampoweredmikej/art/Star-Wars-Jarth-345396804|name=[[Mike Jackson]]|text=SteamPoweredMikeJ's avatar Star Wars - Jarth|quote=Model: Jens Hausser... who posed for me several times back in the day, and yet never looked the same in any of my drawings.}}</ref>
